findings.title: Strict JSON __proto__ property changes local object prototype and outcome
findings.root_cause: Object constructed as {} with out[key] assignment and inherited status read.
findings.consequence: Key lost as own data, inherited authoring status accepted; JSON/YAML outcome comparison and validation can be distorted.
findings.counterevidence: CURRENT SCOPE RESOLUTION: Own-property parser and own discriminator with independent comparisons reject original counterexample.
findings.fix: Construct safe own-property data (Object.create(null) or defineProperty/standard parse plus duplicate-key detection), and discriminate outcomes on own fields.
findings.verification: Verified: N03. Historical condition retained in baseline ledger.

impacts.reason: Input controls allow inherited discriminator values.
